Decided with the operator: trigger = every push to main that changes shipped code (ddflow/, pyproject.toml, uv.lock, Dockerfile, docker-entrypoint.sh, .dockerignore); docs/tests/event-log-only pushes publish nothing. Version source = CI runs scripts/bump.sh minor and commits 'release X.Y.0' to main before publishing; tag vX.Y.0 after everything published. data.rule: In a ddflow checkout, agents append to committed .ddflow/events/*.jsonl continuously, so any tool that diffs the working tree before and after a step (pre-commit's 'files were modified by this hook', a formatter's --check on the whole tree, a 'git status is clean' assertion) fails there at random, and the longer the step the likelier. Run such checks in a scratch worktree of the commit under test (git worktree add --detach), which has no other writers and also tests the commit rather than uncommitted state.
data.title: A check that watches the working tree cannot run where other processes write it
